d.description:
About Numeral

Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

We’re the largest and fastest-growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 3,000 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases.

About the role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll work directly with customers to solve complex technical problems while building the software that makes those solutions scalable.

This is a unique hybrid role. Roughly half your time will be spent working directly with customers, onboarding teams, supporting enterprise implementations, and partnering with Sales and Customer Success on technical engagements. The other half will be spent building software—shipping features, automating workflows, improving our platform, and owning engineering projects from design through deployment.

You'll become an expert in how customers use Numeral and use those insights to make the product better every week.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both solving technical problems with customers and writing production code.

What you'll do

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on technical customer conversations, implementations, and onboarding.

• Debug customer issues across APIs, integrations, and production systems.

• Design and build product features, internal tooling, and automations that improve both customer experience and engineering velocity.

• Own engineering projects end-to-end, from gathering requirements through implementation and deployment.

• Work directly with customers to understand complex workflows and translate them into product improvements.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

• Help improve our APIs, integrations, developer experience, and operational tooling.

• Become a trusted technical advisor for some of our largest customers.

What you'll bring

• 2–5 years of software engineering experience.

• Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js preferred), or experience in another backend language with a willingness to learn.

• Experience working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL.

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

• Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ownership mindset—you enjoy taking projects from idea to production.

• Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity and excited to wear multiple hats.

Even better

• Experience building APIs or backend services.

• Familiarity with AWS, Docker, Redis, or modern cloud infrastructure.

• Experience working with SaaS integrations or enterprise customers.

• Background in fintech, accounting, payments, or tax technology.

• Experience working in an early-stage startup.

What we offer

• Competitive salary and equity—you'll share directly in the company's success.

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App.

• 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security.

• Lunch and snacks when you're in the office.

• Regular team offsites and company events as we grow.

• A culture built on ownership—your work matters, and people will see it.

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

About Truemeds

Truemeds is a technology-driven healthcare platform founded in 2019, on a mission to make quality medicines affordable and accessible across India. Its core philosophy, “Naam ki nahi, Kaam ki Medicine,” reflects its focus on helping customers save on medicine expenses through scientifically matched alternatives to branded medicines.

Truemeds at a Glance:

• 10M+ downloads on Google Play.
• Coverage across 21,000+ pincodes.
• 30 lakh+ doctor consultations facilitated.
• Backed by investors including Accel, Peak XV Partners, WestBridge Capital, and Info Edge Ventures.
• Raised $85 million in a Series C funding round in August 2025.

Explore Truemeds:

• Website: https://www.truemeds.in/
• Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.intellihealth.truemeds
• iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/truemeds-medicine-health/id6742731113
• LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/truemeds-india/

Truemeds promotes a culture centred on ownership, innovation, agility, data-driven decision-making, and collaboration. Employees work across functions to solve business challenges and improve healthcare accessibility.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced performance marketing professional to drive customer acquisition and business growth across paid media channels. The role offers ownership of marketing budgets, channel strategy, creative experimentation, and campaign performance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a sharp, data-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale paid marketing initiatives across media channels and emerging platforms. The role involves managing budgets, optimizing acquisition costs, driving experimentation, and improving campaign efficiency while ensuring sustainable business growth.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of performance marketing, attribution, and unit economics, with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies that drive customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.

What You'll Do

1. Channel Ownership

• Plan, launch, manage, and scale campaigns across major media channels and emerging platforms.
• Test new channels, campaign types, and ad formats in a structured manner, scaling or discontinuing them based on performance.
• Own channel strategy, bidding, budgets, media planning, creative strategy, and key growth initiatives.

2. Budgets and Unit Economics

• Own monthly and quarterly marketing budgets, allocating spend across channels to achieve CAC, ROAS, and payback targets.
• Forecast campaign spend and outcomes, and track weekly budget pacing against planned targets.
• Optimize campaigns for downstream business outcomes, including first orders, quality users, repeat orders, retention, and customer lifetime value, rather than focusing solely on top-of-funnel metrics.

3. Measurement and Analytics

• Work with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer and Singular, GA4, and internal data systems to ensure accurate attribution and event tracking.
• Build and maintain dashboards and regular reports covering channel, campaign, and cohort performance.
• Design and execute incrementality, holdout, and A/B tests to distinguish actual campaign impact from attributed performance.
• Account for reporting delays and attribution limitations when evaluating campaign effectiveness and making optimization decisions.

4. Creative Strategy and Funnel Optimization

• Brief, test, and iterate on ad creatives in collaboration with design and content teams, using performance insights to guide creative development.
• Develop and share creative performance reports with stakeholders, identifying what works, what doesn't, and opportunities for improvement.
• Establish creative playbooks based on performance trends, audience insights, and experimentation outcomes.
• Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and conversion across the customer acquisition funnel.

5. People, Partners, and Stakeholder Management

• Manage agency and platform partner relationships, setting clear performance expectations and ensuring accountability against business goals.
• Collaborate with creative, product, analytics, and technology teams to improve marketing effectiveness and overall business outcomes.
• Present performance results, key learnings, and growth plans to leadership through clear, data-driven recommendations.
• Ensure all advertising activities comply with platform policies and applicable healthcare advertising guidelines.

What You Bring

• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, managing paid media campaigns across multiple channels.
• Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CAC, ROAS, payback period, retention, repeat orders, and LTV.
• Experience with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer or Singular, along with a solid understanding of attribution fundamentals.
• Proficiency in GA4, Excel/Google Sheets, and performance reporting dashboards.
• Demonstrated ability to manage and scale marketing budgets while maintaining acquisition efficiency and business profitability.
• Experience in campaign experimentation, A/B testing, creative optimization, and performance analysis.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
• Experience managing agency partners and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Good to Have

• Familiarity with SKAdNetwork (SKAN) and data-driven attribution methodologies.
• Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel.
• Prior agency experience in performance marketing.
• Experience in healthcare, e-commerce, or consumer-focused businesses.

The job

Responsible for growing Homes’ membership. This role will directly drive most of the company’s revenue growth for the next few years.

The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, ambitious, and loves solving complex problems. To be successful, you’ll need to be a high-agency, regularly flexing between being a leader, builder, recruiter, planner, individual contributor, and manager. Former founders, growth engineers, consultants, or bizops leaders would thrive in this role. The scope of this role is intentionally broad to allow for unfettered exploration of impactful work and flexibility in adjusting scope and focus at any time to maximally drive growth. You’ll span across online performance marketing, offline marketing, organic and referral marketing, supply and market expansion decisions, pricing and packaging, sales, strategic planning, and more.

Honey Homes’ mission is to replace the hassle of home upkeep with comfort and joy. This is a hard problem, but a valuable one to tackle. Our work is a complex and intensive journey spanning software, AI, human labor, and consumer preferences. Getting it right unlocks tremendous value for homeowners, and creates thousands of American jobs. We’re a small and mighty team who enjoy working together, backed by top-tier investors.

This role reports to the CEO and sits on the Senior Leadership Team. You’ll partner closely with the entire company, including Product Marketing, Sales, Product and Engineering, Ops, and the Board.

Outcomes and Competencies

•
Outcomes

•
Drive a 3x+ increase in new members by:

•
Growing awareness of Honey Homes in current and future service areas

•
Growing paid channels and launching new paid channels within target cost metrics

•
Growing and launching organic, referral, and local channels within target cost metrics

•
Informed by up- & down-funnel metrics, improving conversion from website visitor through membership.

•
Finding and removing constraints. Determine what’s limiting growth at any given moment (e.g. demand, lead quality, conversion, market capacity, sales capacity, or something else) and solve it with the team.

•
Driving expansion of service areas into new new metros, in partnership with operations

•
Iterating on pricing and packaging to maximize growth and LTV

•
Accelerating yourself and your team with AI. Create dashboards, tools, campaigns, automations and more with Claude and our proprietary integrations.

•
Become the company owner of acquisition economics by:

•
Creating a useful live model of CAC, marginal CAC, LTV, payback and cohort performance

•
Setting budgets to achieve growth goals that meet payback targets

•
Making capital allocation decisions to maximize growth and LTV

•
Build a high-performing team. Define, recruit, and hire to hit goals and deliver for our members.

•
Competencies

•
You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking. You find unique and as-yet unexploited ways to make make progress.

•
You’re a quantitative, full-funnel thinker. You naturally connect acquisition, qualification, conversion, retention, and LTV. CAC, payback, marginal CAC, cohorts, attribution, and forecasting are the language you use to run paid acquisition. You go deep in the data but know the point of analysis is to make better decisions. You are a data-first problem solver with excellent data analysis skills.

•
You have exceptional consumer and creative instincts. You understand that behind every conversion rate is a person making a decision. You’re curious about what makes customers act, hesitate, and trust. You pair that understanding with strong instincts around messaging, offers, positioning, and creative. You effectively work with creative partners to turn your insights into results.

•
You’re a team and company builder. You can envision what the future looks like, and it’s exhilarating to put together the parts to make that future a reality. You have hired great people in the past, and managed high-performing teams. You believe that hiring is a key part of any role, and you foster a culture of always-on recruiting. You effectively collaborate with partners across the company at all levels.

•
You use AI and technology to create leverage for yourself and your team. You use AI every day to make yourself and your team dramatically more effective. You build workflows and automations, accelerate analysis and research, increase creative velocity, and look for opportunities to personalize and experiment at a scale that wasn’t possible last year.

•
You lead like an owner. You prioritize relentlessly, create clarity across teams, and get people moving toward a shared outcome even if they don’t report to you. You care about Honey Homes’ growth, not just Marketing’s numbers, and make decisions based on what’s best for our members and the company.

•
You’re relentless. You do what it takes to win, no matter what

•
You energize others. Your attitude and leadership brings others with you on the journey every day. You create more leaders with the same zeal that you have.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.

We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live.

What You'll Do

•
Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them.

•
Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers.

•
Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks.

•
Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts.

•
Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again.

Asana is looking for a Head of Content Design to lead and grow our content design practice across the company. You'll manage a team of content designers working across our portfolio of products: Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command. You'll set the standard for how Asana speaks to customers on every surface, from a settings page to a conversation with an AI Teammate. In this player-coach role, you'll lead the practice, develop senior practitioners, and take on some of the highest-stakes writing projects yourself while collaborating with the Asana Design leadership team to shape both what we make and how we make it.

We design the future of teamwork. Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.

Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We're a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds (product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting). We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centred design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.

We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of content designers by setting clear expectations, developing their craft and careers, and building a team with a clear mission and measurable outcomes.

• Establish Asana’s AI voice by defining the voice and tone for AI Teammates and agents, developing conversation design patterns, and distilling characteristics that make humans and agents feel like one team.
• Partner with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Research, and Product Marketing leaders to integrate content strategy into roadmap decisions and make content design a visible, measurable part of how Asana ships.
• Collaborate with Marketing and Brand Creative to ensure a cohesive voice and tone across the entire customer journey.
• Lead high-impact content design initiatives, including flagship launches, AI and conversational experiences, cross-product naming, and information architecture.
• Partner with Research and Data Science to validate content decisions through experiments and user studies, advocating for content improvements backed by evidence.

About you

• Hands-on expertise in UX writing and content strategy for web and mobile products, covering microcopy, nomenclature, information architecture, accessibility, user education, and launch content.
• Experience designing content for conversational or AI-powered experiences, paired with a clear point of view on how products should communicate when systems generate language.
• Experience creating, governing, and scaling voice and tone guidelines and content systems—including AI content tooling—that cross-functional teams actively adopt.
• Proficiency in leveraging both quantitative and qualitative research to inform, make, and defend content decisions.
• Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executives and cross-functional leadership.

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. About Krea

At Krea, we are building next-generation AI creative tools.

We're dedicated to making AI intuitive and controllable for creatives - our mission is to build tools that empower human creativity, not replace it. We believe AI is a new medium that allows us to express ourselves through various formats - text, images, video, sound, and even 3D. We're building better, smarter, and more controllable tools to harness this medium. We recently took this a step forward with the launch of Krea 2, our first foundation model, built completely from scratch for aesthetic diversity and stylistic control, and with Krea 3 - our new image editing model which recently landed at #4 on every benchmarking arena, only behind ChatGPT 2.5 models and above all Google models.

We've raised over $83M and are backed by world-class investors such as a16z, Bain Capital, and Abstract. We work full-time and in-person at our waterfront office in San Francisco. We care about creativity: our team includes musicians, designers, visual artists, and engineers.

This role

We’re looking for a Partnerships Lead to own our relationships with the companies building the world’s leading AI models, including frontier labs, major tech platforms and emerging research teams in image, video, 3D and audio. You’ll bring these models into our product, often on or before launch day. You’ll negotiate the commercial terms behind them, and you’ll turn each partnership into a launch our community cares about.

The role sits at the intersection of product, partnerships, and creativity. You’ll identify and close strategic partnerships, stay deeply informed about the creative AI ecosystem, and drive partnerships from idea to implementation to launch. You’ll own a portfolio of partners end to end, working closely with leadership on priorities while running the day-to-day independently. This role requires strong product instincts, a real understanding of how generative models are built and served and the ability to manage technically complex partnerships.

What you'll do

•
Build and own partnerships with model providers and AI labs, securing early access, launch-day availability, and co-marketing for new image, video and multimodal models

•
Negotiate commercial terms with model partners, including API pricing, volume commitments, revenue share, rate limits, exclusivity windows and SLAs

•
Track release roadmaps across the model ecosystem so we know what’s coming before it ships, and bring clear recommendations to leadership on which partnerships to pursue and why

•
Plan joint launches with partners: timing, narrative, assets and announcements, working with product, growth and creative

•
Lead negotiations with GPU and cloud providers, managing credits, capacity, pricing, and SLAs

•
Work with finance so model and infrastructure deals match budget, usage and margin

•
Act as the internal owner and long-term relationship holder for each partner, and keep relationships strong across multiple launches

What we're looking for

5+ years in partnerships or a related role, with a track record of closing and launching deals

•
Experience working with AI model providers, foundation model labs or major tech platforms, ideally on API or model distribution deals

•
Experience negotiating technical, usage-based agreements (API pricing, capacity, credits, SLAs)

•
Familiarity with generative media, creative tools or the creative AI ecosystem, and a point of view on which models matter and why

•
Strong communication and negotiation skills

•
High ownership, autonomy, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments

Nice to have

Experience at an early-stage or high-growth AI company

•
Existing relationships with GPU, cloud, or model providers

•
Prior experience at a creative tools or design software company

A technical background or working understanding of model training and inference

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. About the Role:

Skydio is looking for seasoned Highway Safety & Transit sUAS professionals to join our team of Solutions Engineers. In this capacity you will support State Highway Patrol, State Police, Capitol Police, Department of Transportation, and other State entities across a territory. A successful candidate has direct experience with Highway Safety & Transit sUAS operations, loves to travel, has a strong understanding of traffic management and transit monitoring concepts of operation, and is detail oriented — able to conduct thorough discovery, capture the customer feedback that guides product development, and work cross-functionally to prepare Customer Success Plans. Exceptional candidates will also bring extensive product knowledge of commonly used highway safety and transit software, including CAD, VMS, and ITS platforms, and a working knowledge of API integrations.

This is a remote role. Travel of 50 to 75% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

About the Team:

The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Highway Safety & Transit sUAS programs.

Conduct product demonstrations and ensure the smooth integration of technology into customer agency operations and existing data management systems, including CAD and dispatch, video management, evidence management, and streaming platforms.

•
Own site assessment quality in your territory. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.

•
Run proofs of concept to a standard: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.

•
Support the airspace path your programs need, including BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and remote and docked operations.

•
Gather and analyze customer feedback to inform product improvements, and work closely with cross-functional teams to support the development and execution of customer projects, including Customer Success Plans.

•
Strong understanding of drone technology, Highway Safety & Transit sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance.

•
Familiarity with Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations. Professional experience is strongly preferred.

•
Working knowledge of highway safety and transit software platforms, including CAD, VMS, and ITS, and of API integrations.

•
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically in high-pressure situations.

•
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a chief or a city council without changing the facts.

•
Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including the judgment to know when to commit technical time and when to decline.

Nice to Have:

Prior service with State Highway Patrol, State Police, Capitol Police, Department of Transportation, or as an agency sUAS program lead.

Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.

Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.

•
Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.

Active FAA Part 107 Certificate.

We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management

• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

• Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Must-Have Skills

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
• Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
• Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
• Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills

• 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
• Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
• Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
• Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

• Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
• Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines

d.description:
You'll own how TraceRoot talks to developers. Everything we publish — the posts, the launches, the docs that read like arguments, the demos — is yours to write and ship. Our growth today comes from developers who found the repo, installed it, and told someone. Your job is to make far more of them find it.

This is a writing job for someone who likes software. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be the kind of person who installs the tool, breaks it on purpose, and finds the story in what happened. The best thing we can publish is a developer explaining something true and specific about debugging agents — that's the bar, and you'll hit it weekly.

We move fast, debate hard, and execute even harder. You'll work in person with me at least 3 days a week. You won't own everything in one summer — you'll pick a channel with me and own that number end-to-end. There's a path into our full-time Founding GTM role; be aware that role adds calls and pipeline to the writing, so converting means growing into the commercial half too.

What You’ll Do

•
Write the things developers actually read — technical deep dives, postmortems, and docs-as-marketing about what breaks in production agents and how to see it. Not thought leadership; specific, useful writing with real traces and real code in it.

•
Run the launches — Hacker News, Product Hunt, Reddit, and X. You'll write the post, prepare the assets, be in the comments answering people all day, and do the follow-through that turns a spike into retained users.

•
Own SEO and GEO — comparison pages and problem-first pages that rank, and getting TraceRoot cited by ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity when someone asks how to debug an agent. This is a compounding channel and it will be substantially yours.

•
Show the product, don't describe it — short demo clips, screenshots, and walkthroughs that make the thing obvious in ten seconds; plus dev-influencer collabs, hackathons, and a Discord where people actually get answers.

•
Know what worked — track which post, page, or launch actually drove installs and traces, and say so honestly, including when the answer is "none of them." We'll set you up in PostHog; you don't need to build it.

Requirements

•
You write, and people read it: a blog, a newsletter, a thread that went somewhere, docs, a README people thanked you for. Any of it counts. Send it.

•
Technically curious enough to be credible: you can install TraceRoot yourself with Claude Code, read a stack trace, and explain what happened without a hand-holder. You do not need to write production code for this role.

•
You have taste in developer content: you know why a post lands on Hacker News and why marketing copy gets torn apart there, because you read those threads for fun.

•
Fast and prolific: you'd rather ship six pieces and learn which two worked than polish one for a month.

•
Strong sense of ownership and bias for action: you own outcomes, not tasks, and you make things happen without waiting for a roadmap or a content calendar.

Preferred Experience

•
You've done this unpaid already: grown an open-source project, run a technical blog or newsletter, or written docs for something people use.

•
In the community: you're around people building agents, and you know who the voices are.

•
LLMs as a tool, not a topic: you use model APIs to research, draft, and repurpose — and you know exactly where that stops working and you have to write it yourself.

To Apply

Send two things:

•
Two sentences on the first experiment you'd run to get more agent-building teams onto TraceRoot.

•
A link to something you built — a repo, a script, a scraper, a landing page, a Discord bot, an outreach system. It does not need to be a growth project and it does not need to be impressive; we just want to see you ship.

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We’re looking for a Content & Campaign Operations Intern to keep a high-volume content engine moving, from the first conversation to the final video. You’ll work with our marketing team on influencer videos and customer stories, and make sure creators and customers always know what happens next.

This is a hands-on, in-office role at our Delhi HQ. It suits someone who enjoys content and coordination equally and likes closing loops.

The Job

•
Find the right creators: Shortlist influencers whose content and audience fit Atlys, and help shape a storyline for each one that feels true to them.

•
Drive videos to go-live: Coordinate with our agency for each creator through the shoot, edit and go-live stages, working towards 180 videos live every month.

•
Pitch customer stories: Reach out to travellers who got their visas through Atlys, explain the testimonial project and pitch the perks, including hotel vouchers and other Atlys benefits.

•
Run testimonial shoots: Bring interested customers on board and coordinate shoots at their location or the Atlys office with the customer, agency and internal team.

•
Close every loop: Track feedback, revisions, follow-ups, confirmations and deadlines across both projects, so no conversation gets lost and every video moves towards going live.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

•
Take ownership, follow up without being chased, and spot delays and blockers before they slow things down.

•
Write clear, engaging, grammatically sound copy, whether it’s a message, a content brief or a basic script.

•
Speak articulately and are comfortable talking to people on calls and in person.

•
Know what makes a creator, angle or storyline interesting, and stay on top of internet trends, memes and pop culture.

•
Can manage many conversations at once, keep trackers up to date and hold deadlines.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

•
Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

•
Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

•
A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

•
Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

•
Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

•
Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

•
Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

•
An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

•
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a GTM Lead to own how ElevenLabs builds outbound pipeline in North America. This isn't a traditional SDR management role. You'll lead a team of SDRs, build the AI agents and workflows that work alongside them, and stay close enough to the work to prospect and sell yourself.

You'll join at an exciting point: a strong SDR foundation is in place, new starters are joining, and more hires are planned as we grow. You'll define the next version of outbound here: what gets automated, what stays human, and how we break into new accounts and segments. Then you'll build it. We're an AI company, and our outbound motion should prove it.

This role is measured in pipeline dollars and revenue, not activity. If you've carried a closing number, built something real with AI, and get energy from developing people and watching your team win, we'd love to hear from you.

In this role you will:

•
Own outbound pipeline for our Corporate and Mid-Market segments in North America, with targets set in pipeline dollars and revenue

•
Lead and grow a team of SDRs, with more headcount planned

•
Stay hands-on as a player-coach: prospect, open new accounts, and coach in the moment

•
Build the AI agents, automations and signal-based workflows that let a lean team cover a large market, starting with ElevenLabs' own products

•
Run go-to-market experiments across segments, channels and markets, and double down on what works

•
Build onboarding, enablement and coaching that grow SDRs into future closers

•
Partner with Account Executives, sales leadership, marketing and RevOps on targets, ICP and a clean handoff to AEs

Requirements

•
8+ years in B2B software or technology sales, including time in a closing seat (AE, account manager or full-cycle seller) where you carried a number and beat it

•
Experience leading people: managing SDRs, AEs or a mix, or building a sales function from the ground up

•
You build with AI, you don't just use it: you've shipped agents, automations or workflows that changed how you or your team sells, and you can walk us through them

•
Recent, hands-on outbound experience with technical and business buyers

•
You work from the numbers that matter (pipeline dollars, conversion, win rate, deal size) and you know CRM and modern outbound tooling well

•
A track record at fast-growing companies; you're comfortable with ambiguity and pace

•
Clear, concise communication, and a coaching style that makes people better

Bonus

•
Early-stage or Series A–D startup experience, especially as a founding AE or first go-to-market hire

•
Exposure to voice AI, AI agents, customer experience, or developer tools and APIs

•
You've already built something with ElevenLabs

•
Experience with globally distributed teams

Location

This role is remote-first and can be done from anywhere in the United States. You must be able to work in ET, CT, MT or PT time zones. We prefer candidates based in San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About FirstWork

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the next generation of workforce operations technology.

We work with companies across staffing, logistics, healthcare, and retail that manage large frontline workforces. These businesses deal with complex, highly manual processes involving hiring, onboarding, document verification, compliance, training, and ongoing workforce management.

We're using AI agents to automate these workflows, working alongside human teams and integrating with the systems businesses already use.

Having raised $15M in our Series A, led by Earlybird Venture Capital, bringing our total funding to $20M, we're entering an exciting phase of growth. With established enterprise customers and a growing product footprint, we're expanding beyond hiring and onboarding to build a comprehensive AI-powered workforce operations platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the intersection of product engineering, customer implementation, and applied AI.

In this role, you'll work directly with enterprise customers to understand their hiring, onboarding, and compliance workflows and translate those requirements into working solutions using FirstWork.

You'll own client implementations end to end, from discovery and solution design to integrations, automation, deployment, and ongoing support. You'll build integrations with external systems, configure AI-powered document verification workflows, develop automations, and work closely with our product and engineering teams to solve customer-specific challenges.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll write code, solve real-world technical problems, interact directly with customers, and see the impact of your work in live enterprise environments.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

•
Work at the intersection of AI and engineering: Build practical solutions using AI agents, automation, APIs, and integrations.

•
Own implementations end to end: Take responsibility for turning complex customer requirements into working product experiences.

•
Solve real-world technical challenges: Work with diverse enterprise systems, complex workflows, and compliance requirements.

•
Work directly with customers: Collaborate with stakeholders ranging from recruiters and compliance teams to senior executives.

•
Shape the product: Bring customer learnings back to engineering and help turn repeated implementation challenges into reusable platform capabilities.

What You'll Do

•
Lead enterprise client implementations from discovery through go-live, translating business processes into working hiring and onboarding workflows in FirstWork.

•
Build and maintain integrations with ATS, VMS, payroll, and HR systems using REST APIs, webhooks, and file-based data synchronization.

•
Design and configure AI-powered document verification pipelines for identity documents, licenses, certifications, and country-specific compliance requirements.

•
Build RPA automations for systems that lack APIs, including workflows such as timesheet entry and credential uploads.

•
Write scripts for data mapping, migrations, debugging, and reporting.

•
Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to implement fixes.

•
Lead client calls, product demonstrations, and implementation status updates, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Work closely with customers to understand their operational challenges and recommend practical technical solutions.

•
Share customer feedback and implementation learnings with the product team to help build reusable features and improve the platform.

What We're Looking For

•
2–6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical consulting.

•
Strong Python and SQL skills, with the ability to read, understand, and debug existing code.

•
Hands-on experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and third-party system integrations.

•
Ability to understand complex or loosely defined business processes and translate them into clear technical solutions.

•
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

•
A strong ownership mindset and the ability to drive implementations through to successful go-live.

•
Comfort working across time zones with US and European clients.

Nice to Have

•
Experience with HR tech, staffing, ATS, or HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or Salesforce.

•
Exposure to workforce compliance workflows, including I-9, W-4, right-to-work checks, background checks, or credentialing.

•
Experience with RPA tools, n8n, or workflow automation platforms.

•
Experience using LLMs for document extraction, validation, or AI-powered automation.

•
Previous experience in a startup or customer-facing technical role.

Why Join FirstWork?

•
Build real-world AI solutions: Work on practical AI applications that automate complex enterprise workflows.

•
Combine engineering with customer impact: See how the systems you build directly improve business operations.

•
Take ownership: Drive implementations from initial discovery to production deployment.

•
Work across technology and product: Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and enterprise customers.

•
Grow with FirstWork: Join a growing applied AI company and help shape how enterprise AI solutions are built and deployed.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

Our partners - card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs - are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.

The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care. There's no playbook.

The Job

•
Own a portfolio of live partnerships - deepen them and grow what they generate.

•
Take 4–5 new partnerships live every month, with most partnerships going from first conversation to live in about two weeks.

•
Run longer-term partnerships that may span months, multiple geographies, and involve product, legal and procurement teams.

•
Write cold outreach that gets a reply from someone senior.

•
Build the commercial construct, not just the relationship.

•
Drive go-live across product, operations and legal to ensure partnerships move from conversation to execution.

•
Own the numbers on every relationship you hold and stay accountable for the outcomes of your partnerships.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

•
Have 0–2 years of experience. Exceptional fresh graduates are welcome.

•
Have no degree or institution filter - we care about what you can do, not where you studied.

•
Write exceptionally well. This is the highest-weighted skill for this role.

•
Can reason from first principles and build a deal structure when there is no precedent to follow.

•
Can be the most junior person in the room and still run the conversation confidently.

•
Have strong commercial judgement and can think about what creates value for both Atlys and the partner.

•
Are patient, input-driven and comfortable with outcomes that can be lumpy while the work remains consistent every day.

•
Take strong ownership and are comfortable building something without a predefined playbook.

•
Communicate exceptionally well and can build relationships with senior decision-makers.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

•
Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

•
Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

•
A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

•
Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

•
Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

•
Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

•
Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

•
An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

d.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Global Affairs team builds relationships with communities to help ensure that artificial intelligence benefits people broadly. The partnership team works with organizations and leaders across education, workforce development, labor, faith, civil rights, and other communities. We build partnerships that help people use AI in ways that matter to their lives, strengthen the organizations serving their communities, and ensure their experiences and concerns help shape OpenAI’s work.

About the Role

We’re looking for a resourceful partnerships professional who combines strong external relationship skills with the judgment and organizational ability to move complex initiatives forward.

You will manage designated external relationships and lead the day-to-day delivery of partnerships across the team’s portfolios and Working with portfolio leads, you will translate agreed objectives into practical programs, represent OpenAI in partner conversations, coordinate internal contributions, and carry commitments through delivery.

You will also step into emerging priorities: helping launch a new collaboration, advancing an existing partnership, preparing a senior leader for an external engagement, or coordinating a project involving several teams. Your portfolio will evolve with team priorities, with clear ownership and agreed outcomes for each assignment.

This role requires someone who enjoys building relationships and doing the detailed work that makes those relationships productive. You should be comfortable working independently, learning unfamiliar issues quickly, and knowing when to seek expertise or escalate a decision.

In this role, you will:

•
Own external relationships. Build and manage trusted relationships with nonprofit organizations, civic leaders, community institutions, and other partners across a range of diverse perspectives and communities.

•
Develop and deliver partnerships. Translate shared interests into practical collaborations with clear objectives, scope, responsibilities, timelines, and measures of success.

•
Represent OpenAI externally. Lead partner meetings and briefings, participate in convenings, and communicate clearly about AI’s opportunities and safe and responsible use.

•
Contribute across the team’s priorities. Take ownership of defined projects across different portfolios, support colleagues during major initiatives, and help establish new areas of engagement.

•
Connect partners with internal expertise. Work with policy, product, safety, legal, communications, and education colleagues to develop substantive engagements and secure the contributions needed for delivery.

•
Turn stakeholder insight into action. Identify concerns and opportunities, synthesize what we hear, bring relevant feedback to internal owners, and close the loop with partners.

•
Deliver funded partnership programs. Translate agreed commitments into feasible workplans with clear owners, milestones, and outcomes. Work directly with partners and portfolio leads to resolve program questions, coordinate implementation, and assess results, including recommendations for improvement or renewal.

•
Coordinate partnership implementation across teams. Bring together relationship owners and colleagues in policy, legal, finance, procurement, product, and communications to move agreements, funding processes, and program launches forward; track dependencies, resolve or escalate blockers, and keep partners and internal teams informed of progress.

•
Maintain reliable follow-through. Manage workplans, partner commitments, budgets, and approval processes for your projects; surface dependencies and risks early and recommend solutions.

•
Exercise sound prioritization. Assess incoming opportunities against team goals, recommend where to invest time and resources, and adjust plans as circumstances change.

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Bring 6+ years of relevant experience in partnerships, external affairs, public policy, campaigns, government, nonprofits, or community engagement, or equivalent experience demonstrating these capabilities.

•
Have independently managed external relationships and delivered complex partnership programs, including scoping commitments, coordinating multiple teams, managing budgets, and evaluating outcomes.

•
Combine political and stakeholder judgment with strong execution skills, including navigating disagreement and sensitive issues.

•
Can build credibility with people whose experiences and views differ from your own.

•
Write clearly, communicate confidently, and translate complex topics for nontechnical audiences.

•
Are organized and responsive, can manage several projects at once, and take responsibility for completing commitments.

•
Work effectively across teams without formal authority and make thoughtful decisions about when to act independently and when to seek alignment.

•
Enjoy a varied portfolio and can move between relationship development, strategic thinking, and hands-on delivery.

•
Are curious about AI and its implications for communities, public institutions, and economic opportunity.

About TypeSafe

We’re building prod, not god. TypeSafe AI is a truly novel AI lab building machine-native intelligence infrastructure for automation – designed to make decisions within software by combining the intelligence of LLMs with the efficiency and reliability of code into a new shape of AI: System One Models.

Our first public model, Jev, was launched just 2 months ago. Adoption has been incredibly rapid, and we now count around one-third of the Fortune 500 as users.

We’re a small, fast-moving team from OpenAI, Google Brain, and Meta/FAIR, backed by top-tier investors like Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia.

About the role

As one of TypeSafe’s first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll be helping to shape how the FDE function delivers value to our customers. You’ll be customers’ primary technical partner, helping them turn promising ideas into production software built on Jev. You’ll work closely with developers and enterprise teams to identify valuable use cases, prove performance, and grow adoption across their organizations.

You’ll also build with Jev yourself: creating internal tools, exploring new applications, and turning what you learn into demos, cookbooks, and product feedback. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who loves understanding customer problems and helping people build.

What you’ll own

•
Help customers discover and develop great use cases for Jev. Understand their workflows, identify where Jev can deliver meaningful value, and help unblock engineering teams technically – whether writing a doc or cookbook, jamming with customer engineering teams, or getting hands-on with code.

•
Growing our developer education efforts at scale. Use your insights to create high-impact cookbooks, documentation, example repos, technical blogs, visual explainers, and case studies that help more developers succeed.

•
Give confident, engaging technical demos and talks whether to engineering execs or at community events. Support hackathons, answer questions, and build lasting relationships with people using TypeSafe.

•
Be a collaborative and trusted technical partner with AEs on technical discovery, demos, and evaluation results that drive deals to success.

We are looking for people who

•
Have great product sense: can intuit what customers are trying to achieve, and what can really move the needle for them

•
Are strong, hands-on engineers: can rapidly prototype eye-catching demos for a customer call, write evaluation scripts, and understand data across a wide range of customer domains.

•
Enjoy working closely with customers: asking thoughtful questions, understanding their goals and organizations, and building relationships.

•
Have sound technical judgment. You understand representative datasets, baselines, precision and recall, thresholds, and failure analysis, and can explain where a model is useful and where it falls short.

•
Communicate clearly with developers and business stakeholders, whether through a technical conversation, a demo, documentation, or example code.

•
Have built in a customer-facing technical role, such as an FDE, solutions engineer, or sales engineer; or bring product engineering, applied AI, or founder experience with a strong customer focus.

•
Thrive in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment: we’re a small team, and you’ll be helping to evolve how FDE works at TypeSafe. You should be able to autonomously navigate that ambiguity to find the points of highest leverage and impact.

Life at TypeSafe

We’re a small, flat, close-knit team dedicated to real-world impact preparing the world for Transformative AI. Our team works fully in-person in our San Francisco office near Embarcadero station. We love what we do and care about our work a lot.

We strive for excellence and craftsmanship and won't stop until we get there. When the team wins, we all win, and we enjoy collaborating and inspiring each other to grow as a team and as individuals.

We also value emotional honesty, kindness, and bringing your whole self to work. We build machines; we don't try to be machines.

We want you to be able to do the most impactful work of your career at TypeSafe and help define our future as a company.

We provide

•
100% covered health insurance

•
Daily lunch and dinner

•
Visa sponsorships

•
401(k) plans

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•

d.description:
About LiveFlow
LiveFlow is on a mission to redefine how businesses manage their finances. We combine AI and automation with hands-on accounting experts to run month-end close, reconciliations and reporting for multi-location businesses, especially restaurant and hospitality groups.

We have raised over $21M from top-tier investors including YC, YC Continuity, Valar, Seedcamp, WndrCo, Moonfire, Bradley Horowitz (VP Product, Google) and more.

We help thousands of companies streamline their financial workflows, and we have hundreds of 5/5 ratings on G2.

Our founding team previously worked at one of the fastest-growing fintechs, Revolut.

About the role

We are looking for a creative content creator who can make magic happen with limited resources and build a brand and following that scales.

Here's what you'll do:

•
Create content and lead creative direction

•
Grow our social channels from zero

•
Run social campaigns, launches, events, and collaborations with other content creators

•
Be involved in PR and other marketing stuff

•
Track what campaigns work and use analytical rigor to inform your next move

Here's what we're looking for:

•
You've built a social media channel to at least 20,000 followers, ideally your own, but if you did it for someone else or a brand, that's also ok.

•
You take an extreme amount of initiative, set and reach your own goals, and get things moving without being told what to do.

•
You're fully AI-native, meaning you're up to speed on the latest tools and constantly improve your workflows for more efficiency.

Here's what we DON'T require:

•
Any kind of formal education.

•
Any kind of formal prior experience at a specific company or industry.

In short, we hire raw and smart talent, and we don't believe formal experience is critical to success, especially in this role. We welcome applicants of any age and background, so please apply!

Benefits

•
Health, dental, and vision insurance.

•
Paid lunch and dinners in-office.

•
Lots of free dinners at prominent restaurants through the content you make.

•
Extensive travel.

•
Rapid learning experience.

Location: New York City.

We are a fully in-office company, but for this role, there will be a lot of flexibility, as we expect you to spend a lot of time (if not the majority) outside the office making content.
